notes.abbreviate_groups: Listed only where two or more crops draw the group as a label: CO2Me (crops 01 and 02) and Et (crops 01 and 02). CN and tBu are drawn as labels in crop 02 only. Ph is drawn as a ring in crop 01 and as a label in crop 02 only, so it is not listed. OMe and Me occur only as text in the crop 02 scope table. CO2Et and SO2Me appear in crop 02 only; SO2Me has no ABBREVIATIONS entry.
notes.new_bond_color: #FF0000 in crops 01 and 02, both from Wang et al. 2025. Crop 03 has no coloured new bond. The second paper has not been checked for this colour.
notes.substrate_colors: Teal #0078B2 in crops 01 and 02 (exact). Crop 03 teal sampled at #0073AC and #0072A7, within 6 units per channel. Second substrate #0000FF in crops 01 and 02, both from one paper. Crop 03 has a single substrate.
notes.reagent_text_color: Plain reagent text is black in all three crops. H2O in the conditions is bold teal in crops 02 and 03; the card records the plain text colour.
notes.substrate_layout: Left null. Crops 01 and 02 both show an inline A + B layout, but both are from one paper, and the stacked form is not seen.
notes.show_plus_sign: Left null. Crops 01 and 02 show a plus sign between substrates, but both are from one paper.
notes.measured_spread: Measured ratios are means of the evidence crops. bond_length_over_cap_height 2.209 from 2.26 (crop 01), 1.60 (crop 02), 2.76 (crop 03); range 1.6 to 2.8. line_width_over_bond_length 0.062 from 0.067, 0.075 and 0.043; range 0.043 to 0.075. bold_width_over_bond_length 0.244 from 0.288 (crop 01) and 0.200 (crop 02); crop 03 has no wedge. arrow_length_over_bond_length 11.1 from 9.3 (crop 01), 12.7 (crop 02) and 11.3 (crop 03); range 9.3 to 12.7, and no single crop matches the mean. atom_label_size_pt_estimate 7.3 is a print-size estimate; the crops carry no print size, so it is not checked against the 6 pt label size of the nature preset.

signature_features: brown rules and rounded boxes separate scope sections
bold compound labels with the yield on the same line after the label
substrate_scope.notes: scope_layout grid from crops 02 and 03. The yield_format is from both crops. selectivity_format comes from crop 02 only (for example 85%, 90% ee); crop 03 has no ee. Crop 03 shows only the top of scope row a.

evidence.observations: Kekulé rings; first substrate teal (#0078B2), second substrate blue (#0000FF), new C–C bond red (#FF0000); bold compound labels 1a, 2a, 3a; catalyst and ligand above the arrow, electrolyte, base, solvent and conditions below; A + B inline; t-Bu written with italic t.

evidence.figure: Fig. 2 scope header and first row
evidence.observations: Same colouring as the table scheme; yields written after the bold label on one line, e.g. 3a, 85%, 90% ee; ligand shown in a grey rounded panel; Ar1/Ar2 in circled ring placeholders.

evidence.citation: Zhao, Jia and Wang, Nat. Commun. 2024, 15, 2415
evidence.figure: Fig. 2 scheme with X-ray panels and scope row a
evidence.observations: Single substrate; the part derived from the substrate (cyclohexyl to phenol ring and OH) teal (#0073AC); H2O in the conditions bold teal; catalysts above the arrow, additives, solvent, temperature below; bold labels with yields after the label on one line (2s, 86%) and R' variants listed as 2a, R' = H, 71%; brown rules and rounded boxes separate scope sections; Kekulé rings.
